en.title: Haydn, String Quartet in D major, Op.64 No.5 – IV. Finale (Vivace)
en.overview: This is a fast finale in D major. A short main tune opens it and keeps coming back. In the middle, the music turns stormy, with minor keys and loud playing. Then the tune returns softly and the movement ends with a loud finish. Keys and chords here are estimated by computer, and some small rhythm details may be imprecise.

listening_points.headline: The main tune, played by Violin 1 alone
listening_points.text: The first violin starts by itself, softly [m. 0]. This is the main theme you will hear again and again.

listening_points.headline: The others join with soft accompaniment
listening_points.text: From [m. 1-7] the first violin keeps the lead. The other players now accompany it. The theme comes back at the same pitch in [m. 4-5]. This opening part is marked to be repeated.

listening_points.headline: A new key arrives
listening_points.text: Part 2 begins with a duet [m. 8]. Then the estimated key moves to A major around [m. 11]. A change of key (a modulation) like this feels like the music stepping to a new place. The first violin still leads, softly.

listening_points.headline: The tune returns, then home to D major
listening_points.text: The main theme returns at its original pitch in [m. 20-21], even though the key label there is A major. Then the key settles back to D major at [m. 21]. The theme comes again in D major at [m. 24-25]. It feels like arriving home.

listening_points.headline: Getting louder into the middle part
listening_points.text: A crescendo marking appears at [m. 28b]. A crescendo means getting gradually louder. The dynamic there is loud (f). It leads into the next part.

listening_points.headline: Stormy minor mood, loud, in duet texture
listening_points.text: Part 3 starts loud, in estimated D minor [m. 29-31]. The mood darkens. The texture is labelled a duet here. The key moves to A major [m. 32-36] and then back to D minor at [m. 37].

listening_points.headline: F major: a brief lighter patch
listening_points.text: The estimated key turns to F major [m. 41-45]. The first violin probably leads at first. Then the second violin probably takes over from [m. 42]. The lead is unclear, so treat it as shared.

listening_points.headline: Keys shift quickly, voices go their own ways
listening_points.text: The music wanders through G minor, C major, D minor and A minor [m. 46-59]. The lines are often independent, which means each player has a different part. No one clearly leads. It is all loud.

listening_points.headline: The viola probably steps forward
listening_points.text: The viola probably carries the tune around [m. 60-62]. Then the first violin takes over at [m. 63]. The key settles on D minor at [m. 62]. The others accompany.

listening_points.headline: A sudden hush, then the tune returns
listening_points.text: The key moves to A major at [m. 67]. The first violin plays alone, loud, in [m. 72]. Then it drops suddenly to soft at [m. 73]. The main theme returns in D major at [m. 75-76].

listening_points.headline: The opening music comes back
listening_points.text: Section 4 begins soft [m. 76]. The theme comes again at [m. 79-80]. The first violin leads and the others accompany. This section has a new key signature.

listening_points.headline: A higher return of the theme
listening_points.text: The estimated key goes to A major again [m. 86-95]. The theme returns at [m. 95-96], one octave higher than at the start. It comes again at that same higher octave at [m. 99-100]. Listen for the bright, high sound.

listening_points.headline: Everyone plays the same line
listening_points.text: In [m. 104-106] the texture is unison or octaves. That means the same line at the same pitch or at different octaves. It is a plain, focused sound, and it stays soft.

listening_points.headline: The tune passes from voice to voice
listening_points.text: The viola plays the theme first, an octave lower [m. 110-111]. Then the first violin has it [m. 112-113]. The second violin follows [m. 114-115]. Much of this is homophonic, where the players move together in chords.

listening_points.headline: The estimated loudest point
listening_points.text: A computer estimate marks [m. 117] as the loudest point, with ff (very loud). The texture is homophonic through [m. 119]. The lead is probably the first violin, but with low confidence.

listening_points.headline: A soft pause, then a loud finish
listening_points.text: The music drops suddenly to soft at [m. 120]. At [m. 124] it jumps to loud again (f). The last bars [m. 125-128] are homophonic. The movement ends in D major.

glossary.explanation: The home base of a stretch of music. Major keys usually sound brighter and minor keys darker.
A move from one key to another.
A short tune that returns during the piece.
A marking meaning the music gets gradually louder.
One player has the tune and the others support it.
Each player has a different line instead of sharing one tune.
The players move together in chords, with the tune on top.
Players play the same line, at the same pitch or an octave apart.
The distance between two notes of the same name, one higher than the other.

zh.title: 海顿《D大调弦乐四重奏》Op.64 No.5 第四乐章：活泼的终曲
zh.overview: 这是一个2/4拍的快速终乐章，主调为D大调。开头的小旋律由第一小提琴奏出，后面会多次回来。中段转入小调，声音更强。最后回到轻声的开头旋律，并推向电脑估计的最响位置。和声与调性是软件估计的，可能有误。乐谱数据中的节奏细节可能有误，所以本指南只讲大轮廓。

listening_points.headline: 第一小提琴轻声唱出主旋律
listening_points.text: 乐章以弱奏开始。第一小提琴在[m. 0]独奏主旋律的开头。从[m. 1]起，其他乐器加入伴奏。这一段是D大调，并且会重复。

listening_points.headline: 进入第二段，转向A大调
listening_points.text: 第二段在[m. 8]以二重奏开始。随后调性转向A大调，从[m. 11]开始。听起来像换了一个明亮的新落脚点。第一小提琴大体仍带着旋律，整体保持弱奏。

listening_points.headline: 主旋律回到D大调，并渐强
listening_points.text: 主旋律在[m. 20-21]出现在A大调里，音高和开头相同。到[m. 21]回到D大调。[m. 24-25]主旋律再次出现。段末的[m. 28b]标有渐强（声音逐渐变大），并变为强奏。

listening_points.headline: 转入D小调，两把小提琴成对话
listening_points.text: 第三部分从[m. 29]开始，调性变成D小调，情绪变暗。音量是强，并有多处突强记号（sf，某个音突然加重）。这里主要是二重奏织体。领奏判断的把握很低，可以视为两把小提琴共同领奏。

listening_points.headline: 短暂的F大调，领奏换到别的声部
listening_points.text: [m. 41-45]转到F大调。领奏可能转给第二小提琴，但把握不高。[m. 45-46]是三件乐器的织体。接着进入G小调。

listening_points.headline: 调性频繁游走，各声部各唱各的
listening_points.text: 这一段调性变化很快：G小调、C大调、D小调，再到A小调。很多小节是“独立声部”，即各件乐器走自己的线条。谁是主角不太清楚，可以看作是共享的。音量一直保持强。

listening_points.headline: 中提琴短暂带头，再回D小调
listening_points.text: [m. 60-62]中提琴可能领着旋律，但把握一般。[m. 62]回到D小调。随后第一小提琴在[m. 63]重新领奏。

listening_points.headline: 转弱，第一小提琴独奏引路回主调
listening_points.text: [m. 67]调性来到A大调。[m. 72-75]是第一小提琴独奏，其他乐器不伴奏。[m. 73]音量突然变弱（p）。到[m. 75]回到D大调。

listening_points.headline: 开头旋律回来，轻声重现
listening_points.text: 第四部分从[m. 76]开始，出现了新的调号。主旋律在[m. 75-76]和[m. 79-80]回到D大调，音高与开头相同。第一小提琴领奏，其余伴奏，音量为弱。

listening_points.headline: 再走一遍A大调，主旋律升高八度
listening_points.text: [m. 86]又转到A大调，与前面第二段的走向相似。[m. 95-96]和[m. 99-100]主旋律回来，比开头高八度（12个半音）。第一小提琴领奏，仍然是弱奏。

listening_points.headline: 几件乐器同奏一条线
listening_points.text: [m. 104-106]织体是齐奏或八度齐奏，几件乐器奏同一条线，声音变得集中。这段仍是弱奏。随后[m. 109]是三件乐器的织体。

listening_points.headline: 主旋律在各声部间传递
listening_points.text: 主旋律先在[m. 110-111]出现在中提琴，比开头低八度。[m. 112-113]回到第一小提琴，高八度。[m. 114-115]由第二小提琴接着奏出。听听它在不同声部间“接力”。

listening_points.headline: 分析标出的最强点
listening_points.text: [m. 117]出现很强（ff）记号。分析认为这里是全乐章最响、最忙的位置。这是软件的估计。此处是主调织体，各声部一起前进。

listening_points.headline: 先突然变弱，再以强奏收尾
listening_points.text: [m. 120]突然回到弱奏。[m. 124]又突然变强。最后几小节是主调织体，以D大调结束。

glossary.explanation: 乐章开头第一小提琴奏出的小旋律，后面会多次回来。
一段音乐的“中心音”和色彩。大调偏明亮，小调偏暗。
音乐从一个调换到另一个调，听感像换了一个落脚点。
几个声部节奏大体一致，像和弦一起前进。
几件乐器奏同一条旋律，可以相隔八度。
各件乐器走自己的线条，没有明显的主角。

warnings: Two repeat patterns fit almost equally well; check whether the performers took the repeats.

The opening (bars 1-28, up to about 14 s) does not match this recording well: the recording seems to play less of the opening than the score shows. The highlight there is only approximate; from the minor-key section on it follows the music.
